corridors.summary: Njikọ earthmoving arụrụ mmanụ, sub-base compaction, ọrụ drainaịjị kọnkrịtị a kwadoro, na inye ihe direct site na kwarị nke e mere n'okpuru otu mandeti gọọmentị.

stages.title: Mgbanwe Nkọwa & Oke Ọrụ
stages.detail: Ndị azụ na-emefe tọn ezubere, ọkwa kemikal, ebe mbufe, na Incoterms site na Ọfịs Ịzụ Ahịa anyị ma ọ bụ brief injinịarịngị.

stages.title: Aseị Labụ Nọrọ Onwe Ya & Nnyocha Title
stages.detail: A na-ewepụ nlereanya lọọtụ maka aseị labụ a kwadoro, nnyocha mmiri, na akwụkwọ ebe mankụmankụ o si tupu nkwekọrịta gọọmentị.

stages.title: Nhazi, Mmezi & Nkwụnye
stages.detail: A na-akụ mankụmankụ, na-aswa ya, ma ọ bụ na-etinye ya n'akpa jumbo 1MT FIBC nwere nọmba, akpa PP 50kg, dromụ nchebe, ma ọ bụ tịpa a haziri ahazi.

stages.title: Mbufe Mba-gaa-Saịtị & Mmbupụ Ọdụ Ụgbọ Mmiri
stages.detail: Mbufe a haziri ahazi na-ebuga ozugbo na saịtị nchepụta ọrụ n'akụkụ Naịjirịa ma ọ bụ temịnal mmbupụ a haziri na Lagos (Apapa/Tin Can) na Port Harcourt.

about.headingAccent: Dị debanye aha na Naịjirịa a nyocharala.
about.narrativeSuffix: na-arụ ọrụ n'okpuru nrubeisi siri ike na gọọmentị ụlọ ọrụ Naịjirịa, nnyocha title mankụmankụ, na njikere mmbupụ—na-enye ndị na-azụ n'ụwa, ndị nkwekọrịta sivilụ, na minịsitịrị gọọmentị onye mmekọ doro anya, a nwere ike isonye.

pillars.title: A Debanyere Aha na Corporate Affairs Commission
pillars.detail: A debanyere aha n'okpuru Companies and Allied Matters Act dị ka RC No.: 9963225.

pillars.title: Njikọ na Federal Ministry of Solid Minerals
pillars.detail: Inweta ihe kwekọrọ na kwarị nwere ikike, liisi, na usoro akwụkwọ title mankụmankụ.

pillars.title: Njikere Mmbupụ & Nchekwube Aseị Nọrọ Onwe Ya
pillars.detail: Aseị labụ maka lọọtụ ọ bụla, nnyocha radieshọn ebe o metụtara, na nkwụnye mmbupụ.
